## Goal

Independent review of access control, client identity, webhooks and data integrity, and fixes for anything that blocks Phase A.

## Context

The repository audit on 2026-11-27 flagged items for this review. Their details are tracked privately by the product owner, in line with the disclosure rule in `docs/SECURITY.md`.

## Scope

- Part 1: full review of access rules, public routes, paid-content exposure, client identity handling, webhook handling, invoicing and refunds, data-integrity safeguards, logging and env handling. The report goes to the product owner privately, not into this repository.
- Part 2 and later: one fix PR per finding the owner approves, with neutral public wording (e.g. "harden client identity handling"), each with tests.

## Out of scope

- Redesign.
- CSP (SC-012).
- Paid-zone exposure tests (SC-008/SC-011).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Private report delivered to the owner, every finding severity-tagged P0 to P3.
- [ ] A neutral summary comment on this issue: number of findings per severity, no specifics.
- [ ] Every P0 has an approved fix PR or an explicit owner decision.
- [ ] All fix PRs come with tests.

## Required tests

- `pnpm test:db` on an isolated local database (expected 121/121), result posted.
- Unit or DB tests for every fix.
- All standard checks green on fix PRs.

## Dependencies

- SC-001

## Priority

P0 · Phase A

Codex
